title: accept the Tests line when it is a list item, or say in the prompt that a leading "- " is refused

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261126-022730-61cc, project ork, item S614:

accept the Tests line when it is a list item, or say in the prompt that a leading "- " is refused

Evidence: gate-2 was refused for "no Tests: N passed, M failed line" when the line was written as "- Tests: 3 passed, 0 failed"
